text: hello. so for the game, we want to take the exact idea that was utilized from gta 3 / vice city / san andreas era engine and stream the content in based on a radius from the player + LoS + LOD, so we can get the most performance and have a sprawling city feel while only giving parts of t he game at a time. we have draw distance but this is not the same thing

events.text: User live-play feedback: material faces flat at distance + phantom merged buildings. Mechanism: LOD quadrant union-AABB invents mass in gaps; uniform 240m radius too short for big textured faces. Rework under req_0537.

resolution: Built the GTA3/VC/SA-era content streaming for the compiled game (the no-V8 loader, standalone + embedded): full-detail geometry now streams in by RADIUS around the player (promotion instant, demotion hysteretic per V30), draws are culled by LINE OF SIGHT (frustum now — the Compile-precomputed VIS lump has a reserved seam in the same chunk oracle), and a derived LOD shell (coarse merged boxes per chunk, volume-weighted colors, nested inside the real geometry so the swap can never z-fight) keeps the whole skyline visible to the horizon — the sprawling-city feel — while only the bubble pays full price. Draw distance unchanged, exactly as asked. New pure engine module framework/world/streaming.zig (partition + LOD + per-frame draw set, 4 unit tests green); gpu/3d.zig static batches gained sub-range draws (one upload, per-chunk draws, zero re-staging); world_loader feeds its batches through it when the world outgrows the 240m detail radius (RJIT_STREAM=0 kill switch, RJIT_STREAM_RADIUS knob; tiny maps keep the old monolithic path bit-for-bit). Physics already streamed (collider windowing) — render now matches. Evidence on the 512-block 507km2 lab (776,084 rows): first frame submits 30 draws = 1,196 detail + 54,836 shell instances (~7% of the city), visually identical to monolithic at spawn (shots/req0524-massive512.png vs -off.png); authored map proof + rjit game verify GREEN (73/73 suites). Next slices: Compile-side VIS lump (chunk-to-chunk visibility for renderer+NPC+audio per V30), bake-side CHUNKS lump (pre-sorted rows so the loader skips its load-time sort), disk-level residency (decode only resident chunk lumps).
